fusions.name: Drawn Mesh
fusions.desc: Casts a mesh of mail rings 5 tiles long for 5 seconds that drags every enemy near it inward. Each enemy it catches is stunned for 0.8 seconds and the mesh deals 10 damage to it.

fusions.name: Cinched Rings
fusions.desc: Cinches the mesh on a target carrying one of your afflictions, using it up to deal 8 damage and leave it [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds. Anything struck moves 30% slower for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Haul the Catch
fusions.desc: Hauls up to 6 enemies within 7 tiles onto you, forcing them to attack you for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Tangled Quarry
fusions.desc: Against an enemy carrying any of your conditions, your armour rises by 12%.
